title: LEMA-DS component catalog
description: Machine-readable catalog of every component in the LEMA-DS registry, generated by scripts/build-component-docs.mjs from registry.json and each component's .stories.tsx file. Regenerated on every build (make build-storybook).

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the build that produced this file.

version.description: LEMA-DS package version (from package.json), matching the git tag used to build this deployment.

name.description: Registry item name, e.g. "ds-button" or "button". Composites from components/ds/ are always prefixed ds-; shadcn primitives from components/ui/ are not.

title.description: Human-readable title from registry.json, e.g. "Button UI".

description.description: Best available description: the story's `parameters.docs.description.component` when present, otherwise the registry.json description.

category.description: Derived from the primary file's path: components/ui/ → "ui" (shadcn primitive, never edited manually), components/ds/ → "ds" (LEMA-DS composite), lib/ → "lib" (shared utility/CVA-variants module, regardless of the registry `type` tag).

importPath.description: Import specifier using the project's @/ alias, e.g. "@/components/ds/button".

dependencies.description: npm package dependencies declared in registry.json.

registryDependencies.description: Other registry item names this component depends on (installed automatically by the shadcn/ds-sync CLI).

files.description: Source file paths (relative to repo root) that make up this registry item.

storyTitle.description: Storybook sidebar path, e.g. "Footer/FooterMega". Absent for lib-category entries and any component without a Storybook story. Combine with the component name to build a docs URL: /?path=/docs/<kebab(storyTitle)>--docs.

props.description: Component props, extracted from the exported `<Component>Props` TypeScript interface (or the inline prop type for shadcn primitives) plus any CVA `variants` referenced via `VariantProps<typeof ...>`. Falls back to Storybook `argTypes` when no interface or variants are found. May be absent or empty for lib entries or components the extractor could not parse — always verify against the source file for exhaustive accuracy.

stories.description: Exported Storybook stories for this component, with their args/code/description when statically extractable.

required.description: True when the prop has no `?` in the TypeScript interface. CVA variant props are always optional (false) since they carry a defaultVariants fallback. Absent when this prop came from the Storybook argTypes fallback (see `control` below) instead of the TypeScript interface.

type.description: The prop's TypeScript type as written in source (verbatim, whitespace-collapsed) — not a resolved/expanded type. Absent when this prop came from the argTypes fallback.

description.description: JSDoc comment immediately preceding the prop declaration (TypeScript source), or the Storybook argType's `description` (argTypes fallback).

options.description: Allowed value set: CVA variant keys (e.g. ["sm", "md", "lg"]) when extracted from source, or the argType's `options` array (argTypes fallback).

default.description: Default value: a CVA defaultVariants entry when extracted from source, or the argType's `defaultValue.summary` (argTypes fallback).

control.description: Storybook control kind (e.g. "text", "boolean", "select"). Present only when this prop came from the Storybook argTypes fallback, used for components where no `<Component>Props` TypeScript interface or CVA variants could be statically parsed.

args.description: Verbatim source text of the story's `args` object, when present.

code.description: Verbatim JSX returned by the story's `render` function, when present.
